title: Ethiopian coffee, prepared with care for global buyers.
intro: Hayked connects buyers with Ethiopian Arabica coffee, professional processing, organized warehousing and responsive export coordination.
aboutTitle: Real infrastructure for coffee preparation and storage.
aboutText: Hayked General Trading PLC is an Ethiopian-owned company supporting coffee buyers and service clients through processing, warehousing and export coordination.
coffeeTitle: Start with your current coffee requirement.
coffeeText: Share the origin, process, grade, volume and destination you need. The export team will confirm current offers and specifications.
serviceTitle: Connected services from preparation to dispatch.
serviceText: Bring processing, storage, quality preparation and export follow-up into one coordinated buyer journey.
qualityTitle: Quality preparation you can discuss clearly.
qualityText: Representative sampling, lot records and buyer approval help keep each requirement connected to the coffee being prepared.
ctaTitle: Tell us what you need from Ethiopia.
ctaText: Share your preferred coffee profile, required volume and destination so the team can prepare the right response.
